completion_decisions: The official arXiv source archive is CC BY 4.0 and supplies exact wind-rose and layout figures.
The missing modified OpenFOAM solver, mesh and CFD-response arrays cannot be reconstructed as author CFD; a declared ADM/Gaussian truth proxy is used instead.
Truth calls and surrogate FEs remain separate scientific work units.
The exact paper truth-call totals are preserved for all three cases.
Twenty-five independent seeds implement the platform protocol because the paper omits a repeat count.
missing_information: OpenFOAM dictionaries, meshes and convergence tolerances
GA genetic operators and convergence threshold

paper.authors: Zhenfan Wang and Yu Tu and Kai Zhang and Zhaolong Han and Yong Cao and Dai Zhou
paper.title: An optimization framework for wind farm layout design using CFD-based Kriging model

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the paper problem, adaptive Kriging-GA method and all three cases on a versioned ADM/Gaussian truth proxy; not OpenFOAM CFD, author code/data/meshes, exact operators, random state, AEP or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: 81 nodes, eight turbines, at least 2D spacing and nearest-feasible discrete repair

decision_variables.resolution: eight selected nodes from a 9-by-9 candidate lattice

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: canonical sorted eight-index set and 16 normalized Kriging coordinates

initialization.resolution: 360 discrete LHS layouts with deterministic feasible repair

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: AEP, truth calls, surrogate FEs and timing for 25 independent seeds

paper_native_cases.resolution: three flat/single, flat/windrose and Gaussian-hill/windrose cases

parameters.resolution: paper population/rates/generation cap and turbine values; isolated model and convergence completions

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 1000 GA generation cap and exact 437/400/399 truth-call totals; surrogate FEs reported separately

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: 360 truth samples, Kriging fit, surrogate GA, optimum truth infill and rank-one refit

update_order.resolution: one optimum infill per adaptive step and fixed-order best reduction

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: target ADM-RANS registered; executable terrain-aware ADM/Gaussian proxy is explicitly non-CFD

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: single west state and normalized eight-bin Figure-6 transcription
